title: Finite support of a rational function's divisor
statement: Let $X$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] with a finite affine open cover whose coordinate rings are Noetherian. Its function field $K$ is the local ring at its unique generic point. At a point $x$ of codimension one, put $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and define $\operatorname{ord}_x(a/b)=\operatorname{length}_R(R/aR)-\operatorname{length}_R(R/bR)$ for nonzero $a,b\in R$; at other points put $\operatorname{ord}_x(f)=0$. For every nonzero $f\in K$, the set $\{x\in X:\operatorname{ord}_x(f)\ne0\}$ is finite. On a smooth connected curve, this makes the sum of orders at closed points defining the principal divisor of $f$ finite.
